# All-public-verb retirement gate

Run the fixed R13 gate only after provisioning and freezing all inputs:

```sh
python3 tools/gomad/scripts/all-verb-parity \
  --bindings /absolute/fn232/all-verb-bindings.json \
  --bindings-sha256 ACTUAL_REVIEWED_BINDINGS_SHA256 \
  --work /absolute/new-all-verb-run
```

The orchestrator accepts input bindings, never commands, coverage counts, a verb
subset or successful adapter claims. It calls the existing foundation, inspect,
replay, exploration, campaign, minimization, qualification/accounting and
installation lanes. These retain their original raw authentication, repeated
executions and own-lineage golden assertions. Qualification includes all five
cells, including onebox. Goldens cannot be regenerated by this gate. The pinned
Python interpreter must run without optimization because existing lanes use
assertions. The release binary also passes the fixture exclusion check.

The bindings schema is `gomad.all-verb-bindings/v1`, with exactly `schema`,
`files` and `trees`. `files` contains exactly `release`, `fixture`, `stress`, `stress-release`,
`determinism`, `divergence`, `reference-helper`, `compiler`, `rust-compiler`, `replay-input` and
`go-base` and `build-receipts`. Each is `{ "path": "...", "sha256": "..." }` with an actual SHA256.
`reference-helper` is the current standalone conformance helper built explicitly
with its `conformance` feature (which enables the guarded `reference-helper` binary), not the historical Go helper.

`build-receipts` is an authenticated JSON object with schema
`gomad.all-verb-builds/v1`, `source_inventory_sha256` matching the candidate-source
inventory digest, and `roles` containing release, fixture, stress, stress-release, determinism,
divergence and reference-helper. Each role has `binary_sha256`, sorted `features`,
`profile: "release"`, numeric `exit: 0` and the actual Rust compiler digest in
`compiler_sha256`. Release features are empty; fixture uses `determinism-fixture`;
stress adds `helper-stress-jitter`; stress-release uses only
`helper-stress-jitter` for the actual matrix; determinism and divergence add
`helper-determinism-fixture`; the standalone conformance helper uses `conformance` (which enables `reference-helper`).
Determinism and divergence may use the same actual compiled binary.

`trees` contains exactly `baseline`, `source`, `cluster-baseline`,
`cluster-source`, `candidate-source` and `compiler-root`. Each is
`{ "path": "...", "inventory": "...", "sha256": "..." }`, where `sha256`
authenticates the inventory bytes. Each inventory line is `SHA256  relative/path`.
Duplicates, traversal, symlink escapes, missing inputs and mismatched hashes fail.
Source and compiler inventories cover every file except `.git`, `.flow` and
`__pycache__`; store their manifests outside those trees. Candidate source must
be the checkout containing this script. Paths resolve relative to the bindings
file; absolute paths are supported. Store binaries outside source trees.

`baseline` is the independently copied fn232 1d7b37f00a custody, with its original
`inputs.sha256`, Go launcher/helper and source archive unchanged. The launcher
and helper hashes are fixed in the orchestrator. Its extracted `source` tree and
complete compiler distribution have separate inventories. The replay lane also
requires its declared independently copied pre-v4 cluster custody and extracted
source. The replay lane retains the existing archive/source pin checks.

The gate probes actual Go and Rust refusal for `qualify-set`, `merge-set` and
`compare-support`. The campaign lane retains actual frozen Go shard/merge
availability and compares positive Rust results to fresh unsharded Go semantics.
The installation lane owns install/discover/doctor/plan/recover, analyze refusal,
and their positive Rust goldens; its .11 endpoints and goldens must be integrated
before execution. A missing lane is UNEXECUTED. No unsupported Go command is
reported as positive Go support.

Stress requires both compiled-role exclusion and a positive matrix endpoint at
`testdata/parity/stress-parity-lane.py`. That fixed endpoint must consume the
existing final-driver stress adapter/145-proof contract and the actual same
frozen candidate/cycle matrix receipt, authenticate its source/role identities
and original 41 cases/four axes/repetitions under `rust/STRESS.md`, preserve Go
availability, and write `stress-parity-result.json` with schema
`gomad.stress-semantic-parity/v1` plus raw `commands.json` streams. Its interface is
`--binary STRESS --ordinary-binary RELEASE --go-binary GO --go-helper HELPER
--go-source SOURCE --go-compiler COMPILER --input INPUT --work NEW_ROOT`.
The producer/reader is still pending; its absence deliberately refuses the whole
gate before execution. A role-refusal check alone cannot satisfy positive stress.
The final-driver owner must integrate this adapter; this gate does not launch a
second stress matrix or accept historical receipts.

Every fixed endpoint must be source-pinned before launching anything. A failed
lane, missing required semantic receipt, missing raw subprocess streams or
unexpected numeric exit prevents `all-verb-result.json`. A successful run seals
all retained outputs by hash and reauthenticates the bound inputs. This is R13
parity evidence, not R12 qualification acceptance or permission to remove CI.
No all-verb run or final qualification has been performed by this source change.

CI retains the existing foundation jobs and adds a mandatory `full-parity` job.
Its authenticated provisioning endpoint must supply a SHA256-pinned tar bundle
with `bindings.json`, copied custody, compilers and actual role binaries for the
checked-out candidate. Set repository variables `GOMAD_PARITY_PROVISION_URL`,
`GOMAD_PARITY_BUNDLE_SHA256`, `GOMAD_PARITY_BINDINGS_SHA256`, and the secret
`GOMAD_PARITY_PROVISION_TOKEN`. The endpoint receives `revision` as a query
parameter. No configuration means failure, never a skipped/advisory job. The
bundle cannot contain symlinks, hardlinks, devices or escaping paths. The
candidate-source binding must point at the actual checkout path on that runner;
provisioning is responsible for its exact candidate inventory. Provisioning must
not run PR-provided executables with credentials. No workflow run is dispatched.

Source-only regression checks:

```sh
python3 tools/gomad/testdata/parity/all-verb-selftest.py
```

The authenticated frozen `source` and `cluster-source` trees remain read-only.
The gate requires its fresh work root outside every authenticated tree, copies
both source trees into `work/derived-sources`, verifies every copied input byte
against a before/after snapshot, and records `derived-source-inputs.json`.
Existing reference lanes create their Go wrappers only in these disposable
copies. The final binding authentication still reads the original input trees;
new wrapper files remain retained derived outputs rather than being excluded
from or normalized out of the original source guard. Do not precreate wrappers
inside a frozen source tree.

The installation lane receives the already authenticated `stress-release` binary
as its required `--role-binary`. Its source-bound build receipt requires the
actual `helper-stress-jitter` compiled role, and its SHA must differ from ordinary
release. This passes `--installation-role-binary`'s distinct-role contract without
executing the supplied executable as a helper. Final role hashes require a
deliberately reviewed installation golden for the final frozen binaries.
